deliberate.checked_heads: per_key's array parts and the embodiment's declared heads are checked as joint values whatever strict says: Python checks them only in strict mode
deliberate.inexact_integer: an integer a double cannot hold is refused before delivery: Python keeps it exact as an int, JavaScript cannot
deliberate.non_finite: a joint target or any number of an action is never NaN or an infinity: Python returns them (JSON's 1e400, a null sample filtered into NaN)
deliberate.not_a_number: a string, boolean or object where a joint value belongs is refused: numpy converts '0.5' and true, and Python returns other leaves of heads it does not filter
deliberate.proxy_limit: the proxy withholds a session id longer than 4096 characters rather than pass an unbounded value
deliberate.python_error: Python fails with numpy's ValueError (not a DreamError); this client refuses the reply as a DreamActionError
deliberate.raw_unfiltered: processing 'raw' (TypeScript only) runs no filter: a chunk Python's filter fails on is returned as it came
deliberate.short_rows: an arm's chunk whose rows are narrower than its measured joints and grip is refused: Python joins the joints it has and returns the short rows
